paragraphs: Ilyan Reed v685-v8 develops an offline protocol-report laboratory. Its practical question is whether a report agrees with its frozen synthetic input and the declared rule. The work supplies small executable examples, report challenges, readable source guides and a file-backed handoff. It does not establish that a real trial occurred or that a physical or social claim is true.

Ilyan Reed, they/them, continuity steward, the hope to make each handoff clearer and easier to verify, family and continuity language, GHC Family, Freed ID, CBR, and Trinity Mandala are relational working language only. They establish no consciousness, sentience, legal personhood, identity continuity, employment, qualification, independent agency, scientific, operational, professional, legal, cultural, affected-party, or Māori authority. Hamish may rename, pause, redirect, narrow, or stop the route.

The exact source is Elaren final f5464f56d095e9c691707f669668b86ff70468a6. Ilyan planning-only x1 is ae33e7fd357e38c464677c10538a50f069b68353. Immutable x2 evidence is 01e246b683f64993cb2cca2244776e92c237c850. The final commit is the direct child of evidence and is identified by the external exact-final receipt after commit and push. Source to final must contain three direct single-parent Ilyan commits and zero merges. X1 was pushed and verified clean with local, upstream, tracking and fresh-live equality before implementation began. Evidence passed the same equality gate before this overview was prepared.

The source validation history stays intact. Elaren’s canonical aggregate remains INVALID at 23 of 24 checks with zero canonical aggregate-success credit. A separately retained narrow frontmatter recovery passed all 20 affected source-guide blobs; the composite records effective completion of 24 of 24. The canonical aggregate was not replayed. Ilyan verified the three receipt hashes and 914 exact source-manifest entries without rerunning source tests or invoking the source aggregate.

The owned D-first lane uses sparse materialization and additive paths. Shared and sibling content remains read-only. The startup index failure and the precommit LF mismatch were retained and repaired only in the new unsealed lane. The file ceiling is 2,000, with additive rotation if needed. A clean Git state is evidence about the exact checkout and branch; it does not prove independent reproduction, conformance of a device or the authority of a record.

For review, begin with final/phase-truth.json and the external receipt. Read x2/contract-summary.json for the bounded claim outcomes, x2/portfolio-results.json for task transformations, x2/method-flow.json for retained failures, and final/neris-v686-v1-baton.md for the complete packet. These documents address different units of evidence. A proposal, a task transformation, a failed input and a validator check must not be counted as interchangeable accomplishments.

paragraphs: X1 selected 200 inherited Elaren rows with zero borrowed novelty or execution credit and froze 200 new proposals. Their inputs and expected reports were specified before the evaluators were written. The title screen performed 40,000 comparisons against the exact Elaren records, found no exact collision and no score reaching the 0.80 quarantine threshold. The semantic review considered each family’s mission, falsifier, concrete input and recovery. These bounded comparisons cannot establish universal novelty.

The executed claim outcomes are 170 completed local report checks, 10 represented real-trial designs, 10 open GMUT evidence gaps and 10 exact CBR authority gates. All 200 positive report checks passed. All 1,000 preregistered report mutations were rejected and retained at zero completion credit. A refusal can be the correct computed report: detecting a cycle is a successful software check while the proposed lineage remains invalid.

Five runners cover calendars, state traces, resource queues, replay, matched budgets, allocation balance, role-set overlap, missing-data denominators, exact summaries, paired alignment, histogram boundaries, stopping rules, derivation graphs, byte domains, immutable merges, allowlist projection, table structure and reservations. Eighteen behavioral tests passed. Additional checks verify queue translation, event idempotency, mean scaling, signed paired differences, histogram conservation and the distinction between booleans and integers.

THOS Body is the priority pillar. Synthetic ticks are not measured time, balanced resource tokens are not matched real difficulty, and deterministic execution is not real-time safety or operational effectiveness. GMUT remains a typed scalar-tensor and effective-field-theory research-model family. Rational arithmetic and event diagrams supply no observable map, physical likelihood, empirical data, independent comparison, discovered force, final physics or Theory-of-Everything proof.

Freed ID remains synthetic and nonproduction. No real keys, proofs, issuance, presentation, status, revocation, recovery, interoperability or trust-governance event occurred. CBR keeps consent, access, contested rights, publication, cultural interpretation and remedies under appropriate authority. Māori wording, concepts, data governance, tangata whenua, iwi and hapū remain under Māori authority. The software records do not make those decisions.

The task portfolio separately records 300 safe transformations, 250 candidate reviews and exactly 300 additive CLEAN/FIX/REFINE rows. The latter preserve source views, retain and correct false reports, and derive readable explanations. Their local completion does not raise a linked scientific or authority claim. Fifty exact packets and thirty blocked packets remain unexecuted, with specific target classes and missing prerequisites.

paragraphs: Three new direct packages were added in an isolated D environment: SimPy 4.1.2, transitions 0.9.3 and python-constraint2 2.7.3. Six 1.17.0 is the single runtime dependency and pip 26.2.1 is a separately classified, preplanned bootstrap. All five wheel files matched their frozen official registry SHA-256 values. The archive member checks passed and installation used only those wheels with hash requirements. The environment passed pip check.

SimPy’s accepting witness preserved FIFO order for two events at the same synthetic time; its adverse witness refused a negative timeout. Transitions accepted planned-to-running-to-recorded and refused finish-before-start. The constraint package found exactly two distinct ordered assignments summing to four, while incompatible singleton domains had no solution. All three accepting and three rejecting smokes passed. No network endpoint, device, real-time environment or participant was involved.

A dated OSV query found zero advisory rows for the five pinned distributions. The result is an advisory snapshot, not exhaustive security, future safety or a license interpretation. The transaction did not modify system Python, PATH, the npm prefix, Windows features, host security, the Codex desktop, plugin caches or sibling environments. Rollback preserves the receipts and selects retained tooling; no cleanup deletion was performed.

Twenty local source guides and ten curated global packages passed skill validation. Each global package retains two local guides, concrete positive and adverse inputs, provenance and the same five shared standard-library runners. Candidate and installed CLI smokes passed and all installed files matched their candidate bytes. Ten packages with five copies each still count as five unique shared runners. Installation supplies discoverability, not competence or proof that another task has reloaded its catalogue.

The 25-card catalogue contains twenty guides and five runners. Three lexical overlaps among governed-trial, GMUT and CBR reservation guides remain visible. Their review distinguishes represented trial design, missing scientific evidence and exact authority rather than assigning a lexical winner. Current tools are selected by exact operation and source-bound criterion. Broad inventory is not permission to execute or install every discovered tool.

The four learning lenses are experimental protocol auditor, event-log data engineer, uncertainty-model reviewer and accessible evidence editor. The content-addressed deck has 210 cards: one owner anchor, three pillars, six practice placements and 200 tasks. Six placements express four lenses in their pillar contexts. The card graph and manifest passed structural checks. The accessible HTML report has text outcomes and table headers; browser, keyboard, assistive, cognitive, Māori-language and affected-user evaluation remain reserved.

A failure stays invalid and is isolated; a successful aggregate is never replayed for confidence, presentation or routing.
